zh:
哥伦比亚大学（Columbia University）成立于1754年，位于美国纽约州纽约市曼哈顿区，是美国第五古老的高等教育机构，也是常春藤盟校核心成员之一。学校下设20个学院，覆盖医学、法律、商学、工程、艺术、人文社科等领域，在校生超33000人，其中研究生约20000名。
哥伦比亚大学地处纽约市中心，拥有得天独厚的地理与资源优势，培养了101位诺贝尔奖得主、4位菲尔兹奖得主、6位图灵奖得主、5位美国总统，其新闻学院、法学院、商学院、医学院均处于世界顶尖水平。学校是普利策奖的颁发机构，在新闻传播、国际关系、经济学、法学等领域拥有全球影响力。2026QS世界大学排名中，哥伦比亚大学位列世界第38位。
en: Columbia University is a private research university in New York City, NY, United States. Founded in 1754, it is the fifth-oldest institution of higher education in the United States and a core member of the Ivy League. The University comprises 20 schools, covering medicine, law, business, engineering, arts, and humanities and social sciences, with over 33,000 enrolled students, including 20,000 graduate students. Located in the heart of Manhattan, Columbia has produced 101 Nobel Prize winners, 4 Fields Medalists, 6 Turing Award winners, and 5 U.S. presidents. It is the administrator of the Pulitzer Prize, with world-leading schools of journalism, law, business, and medicine. Ranked No.38 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
